paragraphs.zh:
Fig. 2a
Ganzseitige Abbildung, quer (um 90 Grad gedreht) auf das Hochformat gesetzt. Die Seite trägt außer dem Kopf 'EP 2 045 236 A1' und der Seitenzahl '18' keinen Text; die einzige auf dem Blatt gedruckte Beschriftung der Abbildung lautet wörtlich 'Fig. 2a'. Dargestellt ist ein Infrarotspektrum als einzelne durchgezogene Kurve in einem rechteckigen Rahmen.
Abszisse: 'Wellenzahl cm-1', beschriftet mit 3500, 3000, 2500, 2000, 1500, 1000, also von links nach rechts fallend. Der Rahmen reicht über die äußeren Teilstriche hinaus, geschätzt von etwa 4000 cm-1 links bis etwa 600 cm-1 rechts (Randwerte nicht beschriftet, daher geschätzt).
Ordinate: nur Zahlen 0,0 / 0,1 / 0,2 / 0,3 / 0,4, ohne gedruckte Achsenbezeichnung und ohne Einheit. Der Rahmen reicht bis knapp über 0,45. Die Achse wächst nach oben, und die Banden zeigen nach oben, von einer Grundlinie bei etwa 0,015; es ist also eine Extinktionsdarstellung (Absorption nach oben) und keine Transmissionsdarstellung (Banden nach unten).
Verlauf: von etwa 4000 bis etwa 1750 cm-1 nahezu flache Grundlinie mit nur sehr schwachen Andeutungen im Bereich um 3000 bis 2900 cm-1. Bei etwa 1700 cm-1 setzt die Bandenstruktur steil ein. Zwischen etwa 1700 und 600 cm-1 liegt ein dicht besetzter Fingerprintbereich mit grob geschätzt 35 bis 45 unterscheidbaren Maxima. Die stärkste Bande liegt bei ungefähr 1100 cm-1 (Höhe etwa 0,47), unmittelbar daneben eine fast ebenso hohe bei ungefähr 1140 cm-1; weitere auffällige Banden bei ungefähr 1290 cm-1 (etwa 0,35), ungefähr 965 cm-1 (etwa 0,32) und ungefähr 650 cm-1 (etwa 0,29). Alle diese Lagen sind grob vom Diagramm abgelesen und ausdrücklich nur Näherungen; die genauen Werte stehen in den Tabellen und nicht hier.
paragraphs.en:
Fig. 2a
Full-page figure, set landscape (rotated 90 degrees) on the portrait sheet. Apart from the running header 'EP 2 045 236 A1' and the page number '18' the sheet carries no text; the only figure caption printed on the sheet reads, verbatim, 'Fig. 2a'. What is plotted is an infrared spectrum, a single continuous trace inside a rectangular frame.
X axis: labelled 'Wellenzahl cm-1' (wavenumber, cm-1), with printed ticks at 3500, 3000, 2500, 2000, 1500 and 1000, so wavenumber DECREASES from left to right. The frame extends past the outer ticks; extrapolating the even tick spacing, the plotted range is approximately 4000 cm-1 at the left edge to approximately 600 cm-1 at the right edge. Those two end values are not printed and are therefore estimates.
Y axis: numbers 0.0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4 only, with NO axis title and NO unit printed. The frame top sits a little above 0.45. The axis increases upward and the bands point UPWARD from a baseline at roughly 0.015, so this is an absorbance-style presentation (peaks up), not a transmission presentation (bands down).
Shape of the trace: an almost flat baseline from about 4000 down to about 1750 cm-1, with only very weak features around 3000 to 2900 cm-1. Band structure begins abruptly at about 1700 cm-1. Between roughly 1700 and 600 cm-1 there is a densely populated fingerprint region with, very roughly, 35 to 45 distinguishable maxima. The strongest band is at approximately 1100 cm-1 (height about 0.47), with a nearly equal one immediately beside it at approximately 1140 cm-1; other prominent bands sit at approximately 1290 cm-1 (about 0.35), approximately 965 cm-1 (about 0.32) and approximately 650 cm-1 (about 0.29). Every one of these positions was read coarsely off the plot and is stated as an approximation only. The exact values are printed in the tables in the description and are not taken from this sheet.
paragraphs.notes: FIGURE LABEL: the sheet DOES print a label and it reads verbatim 'Fig. 2a', set in large bold type at the lower left of the rotated figure (which is the bottom left of the sheet as bound). It is used here as the paragraph marker. Note the wording differs from the description: [0018] calls the six figures 'Abbildung 1', 'Abbildung 1a' and so on, while the figure sheets themselves print 'Fig.'. The number and suffix match, so this sheet is Abbildung 2a. WHICH ABBILDUNG: per [0018] Abbildung 2a is the infrared spectrum of crystal modification II. Two independent pieces of evidence agree. First, the printed label 'Fig. 2a' names it directly, so the identification does NOT rest on the sheet's position in the sequence (the brief warns that the eight sheets do not map one to one onto the six Abbildungen, and position alone would have been unsafe here). Second, the content is consistent with an infrared spectrum rather than a Raman spectrum: the x axis runs to about 4000 cm-1 and decreases left to right, which is the conventional infrared presentation, the ordinate is a 0.0 to 0.45 absorbance-like scale with no unit, and the trace is a flat baseline above about 1750 cm-1 with all structure crowded below it. AXIS DIRECTION: intensity runs UPWARD and the bands point up. This is worth stating because a transmission infrared spectrum often prints bands downward; this one does not, it is plotted absorbance-style. PEAK POSITIONS ARE APPROXIMATE: the positions given above were obtained by linear interpolation between printed ticks on a coarse raster image, are good to no better than about plus or minus 30 cm-1, and are recorded only so a later pass can sanity-check the table against the picture. They are NOT to be used as data. The exact band positions for the infrared spectra are printed in the tables in the description and that is the only place they should be taken from. Nothing on this sheet was copied from those tables. NO TEXT LAYER: this sheet carries only the 19 characters of the running header and the page number. The figure itself, including the words 'Fig. 2a' and 'Wellenzahl cm-1', is raster image and was read off the pixels. To read the rotated captions the page was rotated 90 degrees clockwise and re-read; both orientations agree. Y AXIS UNIT: none is printed. The numbers 0.0 to 0.4 stand alone with no axis title, so the quantity is inferred from the shape of the trace and is NOT stated on the page. Recorded as an inference, not as a reading.

discrepancies.what: The sheets label the figures 'Fig. N' while the description labels them 'Abbildung N'. Same numbering, different word.
discrepancies.text_says: [0018] enumerates Abbildung 1, Abbildung 1a, Abbildung 2, Abbildung 2a, Abbildung 3, Abbildung 3a.

illegible: The exact numeric positions of the individual infrared bands. They are not annotated on the plot and cannot be read off a raster spectrum. The approximate positions given in the paragraph are interpolations between printed ticks and are marked as approximate; the exact values live in the tables in the description.
The y axis quantity and its unit. The tick numbers 0.0 to 0.4 are printed but no axis title is printed beside them, so the quantity is not readable from this sheet.
doc_part_note: doc_part normalised to 'drawings' by the run owner after the V pass. The prompt's enum is front_page|claims|description and has no value for a figure sheet, so the six sheet agents split three and three between 'description' and 'drawings' on identical pages. Nothing validates this field (build_enriched.py:157 and make_visual_evidence.py:980 pass it through as a label), so the honest value is kept and made consistent rather than forced back into an enum that cannot express it. The agents' own reasoning is preserved in each file's notes.
blank_line_note: Blank lines inside paragraph zh/en were removed by the run owner. They came from the markdown-table convention this run uses to carry table content in the paragraph. build_enriched.py emits them into the enriched document, but english_by_line() in resolve_translations.py builds its `body` with `if t.strip()`, dropping blanks, while splitting the paragraph without dropping them. Any interior blank line therefore desynchronised the walk and it aborted, by design rather than guessing, which blocked verify.py for the whole run. Only whitespace-only lines were removed; every character of content is unchanged, asserted at the time of the edit.
